searchTerms.title: Search podcasts by keyword
searchTerms.description: Find podcasts about these topics (uses the Apple Podcasts directory).

podcasts.title: Podcast URLs
podcasts.description: Apple Podcasts URLs (https://podcasts.apple.com/gb/podcast/.../id1234567890) or RSS feed URLs.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter Apple Podcasts country code for search, e.g. us, gb.

includeOwnerContact.title: Include owner name & email from RSS
includeOwnerContact.description: Reads each podcast's public RSS feed for the owner name and contact email (where published), last episode date and episode count.

maxEpisodesPerPodcast.title: Episodes per podcast
maxEpisodesPerPodcast.description: Also save the latest N episodes of each podcast as separate rows (0 = podcasts only).

activeWithinDays.title: Only active podcasts (days)
activeWithinDays.description: Keep only podcasts that released an episode in the last N days (0 = no filter).
